entities.name: Angelė Rupšienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Angelė Rupšienė is a retired Lithuanian professional basketball player, who most notably played for BC Kibirkštis Vilnius. She won two gold medals in the 1976 Montreal Olympics and 1980 Moscow Olympics, three gold medals during European Championship and two gold medals during World Championship, playing for Soviet Union national basketball team.
